chunking.note: first window is zero-padded by 6 frames on the left (start -6); a window shorter than 1500 is zero-padded at the end before the session and its padding dropped after

postprocessor: minimal: a frame is a beat (downbeat) when its logit is the maximum over 7 frames and > 0; adjacent peaks (gap <= 1 frame) merged to their mean; downbeats moved to the nearest beat and de-duplicated; frames / 50 = seconds

audio.f32.what: 32 s synthetic 4/4 at 110 bpm, 22050 Hz mono, peak 0.9: kick on 1 and 3 (downbeat accented), snare on 2 and 4, hats on the eighths, a bass note on each downbeat alternating C2 and G1, a quiet C and G triad pad changing by the bar

chunk0.f32.what: the first window exactly as fed to the export (6 zero frames, then logmel frames 0..1493)

chunk0-beat.f32.what: the export's beat logits for chunk0

chunk0-downbeat.f32.what: the export's downbeat logits for chunk0

beat-logits.f32.what: stitched full-length beat logits (keep_first, borders dropped; -1000 where no window covers a frame)

expected.json.what: the package's (Audio2Beats, dbn=False) beats and downbeats in seconds, tempo = 60 / median inter-beat interval, beats-per-bar counts (beats strictly between consecutive downbeats, plus one), modal count, Study 41 label and its tempo
